#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <limits>

using namespace std;

const double epsilon = 1e-8;

struct Point {
    double x, y;
    Point() : x(0), y(0) {}
    Point(double x, double y) : x(x), y(y) {}
    bool operator==(const Point& other) const {
        return fabs(x - other.x) <= epsilon && fabs(y - other.y) <= epsilon;
    }
    double distance(const Point& other) const {
        return hypot(x - other.x, y - other.y);
    }
};

struct Line {
    double a, b, c;
    Line(const Point& p, double angle) {
        a = sin(angle);
        b = -cos(angle);
        c = -p.x * a - p.y * b;
    }
    Line(double a, double b, double c) {
        double h = hypot(a, b);
        this->a = a / h;
        this->b = b / h;
        this->c = c / h;
    }
    Point intersect(const Line& other) const {
        double det = b * other.a - a * other.b;
        if (fabs(det) <= epsilon) {
            return Point(numeric_limits<double>::quiet_NaN(), numeric_limits<double>::quiet_NaN()); // parallel
        }
        double x = (c * other.b - b * other.c) / det;
        double y = (a * other.c - c * other.a) / det;
        return Point(x, y);
    }
    bool parallel(const Line& other) const {
        return fabs(a * other.b - b * other.a) <= epsilon;
    }
    Line perpendicular(const Point& p) const {
        return Line(-b, a, b * p.x - a * p.y);
    }
    double value(const Point& p) const {
        return a * p.x + b * p.y + c;
    }
    vector<Point> intersect(const class Circle& circle) const;
    bool operator==(const Line& other) const {
        if (!parallel(other))
            return false;
        if (fabs(a * other.c - c * other.a) > epsilon || fabs(b * other.c - c * other.b) > epsilon)
            return false;
        return true;
    }
};

struct Circle {
    Point center;
    double radius;
    Circle(const Point& c, double r) : center(c), radius(r) {}
    vector<Point> intersect(const Circle& other) const {
        double dist = center.distance(other.center);
        if (dist < epsilon) {
            return vector<Point>(); // coincident or same center
        }
        // line for intersection points
        double a = 2 * (other.center.x - center.x);
        double b = 2 * (other.center.y - center.y);
        double c = other.radius * other.radius - radius * radius + center.x * center.x - other.center.x * other.center.x + center.y * center.y - other.center.y * other.center.y;
        Line line(a, b, c);
        vector<Point> res = line.intersect(*this);
        return res;
    }
};

vector<Point> Line::intersect(const Circle& circle) const {
    double dist = fabs(value(circle.center));
    if (dist > circle.radius + epsilon) {
        return vector<Point>();
    }
    Point inter = intersect(Line(perpendicular(circle.center)));
    if (fabs(dist - circle.radius) < epsilon) {
        return vector<Point>{inter};
    }
    double shift = sqrt(circle.radius * circle.radius - dist * dist);
    vector<Point> result;
    result.emplace_back(inter.x + shift * b, inter.y - shift * a);
    result.emplace_back(inter.x - shift * b, inter.y + shift * a);
    return result;
}

struct UnionFind {
    vector<int> parent, rank;
    int count;
    UnionFind(int n) : parent(n), rank(n, 0), count(n) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            parent[i] = i;
    }
    int find(int x) {
        if (parent[x] != x)
            parent[x] = find(parent[x]);
        return parent[x];
    }
    bool unite(int x, int y) {
        int rx = find(x);
        int ry = find(y);
        if (rx == ry)
            return false;
        if (rank[rx] < rank[ry]) {
            parent[rx] = ry;
        } else {
            parent[ry] = rx;
            if (rank[rx] == rank[ry])
                rank[rx]++;
        }
        count--;
        return true;
    }
    int getCount() const {
        return count;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    vector<int> x(n), y(n), r(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> x[i] >> y[i] >> r[i];
    }
    vector<Circle> circles;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        circles.emplace_back(Point(x[i], y[i]), r[i]);
    }
    vector<Point> points;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < i; ++j) {
            vector<Point> inters = circles[i].intersect(circles[j]);
            for (const auto& p : inters) {
                points.push_back(p);
            }
        }
    }
    vector<bool> bad(points.size(), false);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < points.size(); ++i) {
        for (size_t j = 0; j < i; ++j) {
            if (points[i] == points[j]) {
                bad[i] = true;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    int nVertices = 0;
    for (bool b : bad) {
        if (!b)
            nVertices++;
    }
    int nEdges = 0;
    UnionFind uf(points.size());
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        int current = 0;
        vector<int> onThis;
        for (size_t j = 0; j < points.size(); ++j) {
            if (!bad[j]) {
                double dist = circles[i].center.distance(points[j]);
                if (fabs(dist - r[i]) < epsilon) {
                    current++;
                    onThis.push_back(j);
                }
            }
        }
        for (size_t j = 1; j < onThis.size(); ++j) {
            uf.unite(onThis[j], onThis[0]);
        }
        nEdges += max(current, 1);
    }
    int nComponents = uf.getCount() - count(bad.begin(), bad.end(), true);
    cout << 1 + nEdges - nVertices + nComponents << "\n";
    return 0;
}
